subject: E-3270: upload stalls on Linux
body:
Good morning. My setup is MeshMail 2.8.5, Ubuntu 24.04.
Starting the weekend, the moment I start a sync a dialog
reads 'E-3270: upload stalled at 0 bytes/s'.

Power management was set to the battery-saver profile
recently. Uploads stall as soon as the screen turns off.

Before writing in I tried waiting a day; same error
afterwards.

Thanks, Kenji Sato (Ferro & Sons)
